Lost Tower#000.src: Hey, adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#000.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님! 잠깐 도와주실 수 있나요? 곤란한 일이 좀 생겼거든요.

Lost Tower#001.src: A long time ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#001.dst: 오래전 {p}이(가) 파괴되기 전, 우리 가문엔 강대한 힘을 지닌 장소와 존재에 대한 지식이 담긴 꽤 흥미로운 책이 있었어요.

Lost Tower#003.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#003.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님! 잠깐 도와주실 수 있나요? 곤란한 일이 좀 생겼거든요.
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#004.dst: 오래전 {p}이(가) 파괴되기 전, 우리 가문엔 강대한 힘을 지닌 장소와 존재에 대한 지식이 담긴 꽤 흥미로운 책이 있었어요.
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#005.dst: 안타깝게도 {p}을(를) 파괴한 습격 때 어떤 생물이 그 책을 훔쳐 갔고, 그 뒤로 아무도 본 적이 없어요.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#006.dst: 도와주실 거라면 [{~} Book of the Bones]를 가져다주세요. 지금은 {p}의 오래된 탑에 있는 해골들 손에 있을 거예요.
Lost Tower#006.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#007.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#007.dst: 그 탑을 찾아보세요. 아마 안에 있는 해골 중 하나가 책을 가지고 있을 거예요.
Lost Tower#007.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#008.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#009.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.

Lost Tower#010.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#011.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#011.dst: 좋아요! 정말 흥미롭게 읽을 수 있겠어요, 고마워요!
Lost Tower#011.speaker: Laen
